title: WalkthroughAvailabilityDocument
description: The one staff calendar that walkthrough slots come from: weekly windows in India time, a slot length, a lead time and closed dates. Server-only; the website reads open slots through getWalkthroughSlots, which names no staff. No document means booking is closed and the website shows its request form.

utcOffsetMinutes.description: India keeps UTC+05:30 all year; slots are computed with this fixed offset, never a daylight-saving rule.

revision.description: Raised by one on every save; a save names the revision it read.
